name: Jodah
title: The Eternal Archmage
summary: An exceptionally long-lived wizard who preserved magical knowledge across the Dark Age and Ice Age.
biography: Jodah emerged during the troubled centuries that followed the Brothers’ War. His early experiences took place when magical knowledge was feared and its practitioners could face persecution.
His remarkable lifespan allowed him to witness centuries of Dominarian history. Alongside Jaya Ballard, he played an important role in the struggle against Lim-Dûl during the Ice Age.
Jodah survived into much later ages, becoming a living connection between the ancient history of Dominaria and its newer generations.

Jodah's long memory should not be mistaken for political authority over every age he witnessed. His role as a preserver of knowledge was shaped by the aftermath of the Brothers' War and by the danger of treating magic itself as criminal during the Dark Age.

His partnership with Jaya during the threat from Lim-Dûl connected scholarship to diplomacy and immediate defense. Bringing Kjeldoran and Balduvian rivals into cooperation required more than defeating an enemy; their communities had to recognize a future that extended beyond their local conflicts.

The Jodah portrayed in Dominaria United is a much later public figure. Its printing provides a retrospective connection to these earlier events, not an eyewitness depiction of a particular Ice Age battle or meeting.

featuredCard.significance: A later depiction of Jodah, whose life spans multiple major historical periods.
